card.law_is_about: Increasing the greenhouse-gas reduction quota for transport fuels and implementing RED III.
card.they_want: Lower the quota and prevent further increases.
card.the_problem: It starts in 2040; however, the same 59% also applies in 2045, so an error depends on reading the sentence as an endpoint claim.

request_quote.translation_en: Translation of request fragment: be corrected downward

locator.paragraph: Same paragraph, sentence explicitly concerning the quota level.

locator.section: Article 1 number 7(b), proposed BImSchG§ 37 a(4)sentence 2 number 20

correction: The government bill specifies 59% from 2040. A continuing 59% requirement in 2045 would also follow from that open-ended wording, but the paragraph presents 2045 as the endpoint of the increase; the bill completes that increase in 2040.
effect: If read as the first attainment year, correction would show the criticised quota arriving sooner. That endpoint reading remains unresolved.
limits: The 59% level is correct. This appears compatible with an isolated date slip and does not refute the author’s concerns about feedstocks, fraud or the appropriate quota. No intent is inferred. A literal reading that 59% also applies in 2045 is true; the mismatch is the stated timing of the increase.
materiality_explanation: Minor editorial judgment: a five-year endpoint error in one supporting description. Other sections correctly give 2040 dates for separate advanced-fuel targets, and the policy case does not depend on this date.
direction_explanation: Null: no proved error. If the endpoint interpretation were established, the later date would understate ambition and direction would be false.
